statement: The community rumble table specifies frequency encoding as a log2 frequency transform and piecewise amplitude indices; the output format carries four bytes per left/right motor with high- and low-frequency/amplitude band fields. Community notes describe neutral words and warn that table extremes can damage actuators. Kernel and SDL implement *host encoders*; OpenPuck implements an emulator reduction rather than verified physical motor response.

applicability.revision: dekuNukem b354f21 / Linux 4056b3c / SDL 535d80b / OpenPuck 29f4d1e (as cited); retail firmware not measured
applicability.scope: rumble_data_table.md lines 1-55, 55-332; bluetooth_hid_notes.md 43-65. This source-derived encoding is distinct from any proof of a specific physical amplitude/frequency response.
